title: Project Nexus
description: A new game from SyKoNetwork. Something big is brewing — details coming soon.

title: Hex Tac Toe
description: A strategic twist on the classic game Tic Tac Toe.

title: DungeonExpanse External Addon
description: External addon for adding rooms to the Dungeon Expanse Addon.

title: Dungeon Expanse!
description: Completely randomized new dungeons in your world! No dungeon is ever the same — be prepared for a dangerous, dark, and intense plundering experience.

title: GraveDesire
description: Adds a gravestone that is created when a player dies, keeping your items safe until you return.

title: Return Anchors (Multiplayer Home Teleport)
description: A survival vanilla-style home teleport system! No need for "/home" — craft and place the anchor block yourself.

title: Natural Trees
description: Modifies vanilla trees to have a more real-world appearance without adding extra tree types, giving your world a fresh natural look.

title: Ender Elevators V3
description: Adds the Enderporter and Omniporter blocks to your Minecraft world, giving you a fun, seamless new way to move around your base.

title: Permanence - Per Player Keep Inventory
description: Per-player keep inventory for multiplayer worlds — letting some players keep their items on death while others keep the classic survival challenge.

title: Cyanosis
description: A NeoForge Minecraft survival mod in which a fungal infection spreads across blocks, mobs, and dimensions through ten escalating world stages.

title: Create: Air Quality
description: A Create addon mod that adds air quality mechanics, pollution sources, and air purifiers to your world.

title: The Little Things
description: Adds over 100 recipes to uncraft those little mistakes when you craft a few too many items — works on Servers, Realms, and Single Player worlds.
